[SWS_DM_01075] Maximum number of sourceDataIdentifiers in the re- quest
⌈
If the DM receives an the UDS service ’DynamicallyDefineDataIdentifier’ (0x2C)
and the number of sourceDataIdentifiers in the request is larger than the configured
DiagnosticDynamicallyDefineDataIdentifier.maxSourceElement, the DM
shall send NRC 0x31 (requestOutOfRange).
⌋
